Taylor (People Ops): Heads-up: Townhall Fri 11am PT (HQ + Zoom). Short agenda below and two asks — drop questions here or use the anonymous form: https://forms.redwood.internal/townhall-qna (closes Thu 6pm).

Taylor (People Ops): Agenda (30m):
• 10m — Exec update & company metrics (Zoe)
• 7m — Product: playbook launch + next steps (Arjun)
• 5m — Eng: rollout plan + perf highlight (Marta)
• 4m — Policy: security retention tweak + CoC reminder (Drew)
• 3m — GTM: partner milestone + renewals heads-up (Nia)
• 1-?m — Rapid Q&A (may run a bit long)

Taylor (People Ops): Asks: 1) Upload slides to drive.redwood.internal/townhall/may by Thu 3pm. 2) If you want to demo, post a 1-line blurb + infra/co-host needs.

Drew (Security): Quick flag: proposing internal logs retention change from 120d → 60d to cut storage costs; no change to Dedicated customer defaults. I'll share a scoped brief during the slot.

Arjun (Product): We'll add a 30s customer quote after product. Slides incoming Wed morning.

Marta (Eng): Eng demo will be a 30s clip of KV-prefetch (internal bench ~14% p99). Need co-host for screen share.

Zoe (CEO): One ask for leaders: call out one blocker and one recent win during your updates.

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "Townhall  Playbook & Policy" Fri 11:00 PT  Zoom link pinned to calendar.

Taylor (People Ops): Recording + captions will be posted to #all-hands-recordings within 24h. If you want clips or timestamps, DM me and we'll surface them in the follow-up. See you all Friday! :loudspeaker:
